 ENHYPEN's JUNGWON, JAKE & SUNGHOON shine as vivo Friends for V80 smartphone launch
 SPINS 
 560 
 Estimated:   reading 
 Words by Hidzir Junaini 
 First published: 16 November 2026 
 Last updated: 16 November 2026 
 News 
 Tech & Business 
 ENHYPEN members JUNGWON , JAKE , and SUNGHOON have been unveiled as the newest vivo Friends , joining the smartphone brand's latest campaign across selected Asia-Pacific markets, including Singapore.
 Announced on 16 November , the collaboration coincides with the debut of the vivo V80 , the company's latest portrait-focused smartphone, which combines advanced photography features with a design inspired by individuality and self-expression.
 Centred around the theme "Shine as We Are" , the campaign celebrates the idea that everyone has their own moment to shine. It brings together the three ENHYPEN members' distinctive personalities and individual styles, reflecting vivo's efforts to connect with a younger generation through fashion, creativity, and photography.
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by vivo Singapore (@vivo_singapore) 
 As part of the campaign, JUNGWON, JAKE, and SUNGHOON have each photographed a series of portraits using the vivo V80, showcasing the smartphone's ZEISS Center-Stage Portrait features at 85mm and 100mm focal lengths.
 The resulting images highlight a different side of each member. JUNGWON's portraits embrace a curious, playful spirit under the theme Keep Wondering , while JAKE's Bloom Bright captures a relaxed and youthful energy. SUNGHOON, meanwhile, adopts a more composed aesthetic for In My Own Rhythm .
 The collaboration also introduces the V80's new Starwish Purple colourway, inspired by the brilliance of a star-filled galaxy. Featuring shimmering starlight elements, the design reflects the campaign's message of celebrating individuality and finding confidence in one's own identity.
 Beyond its visual design, the V80 places an emphasis on portrait photography, incorporating ZEISS imaging technology and an AI Creative Camera to give users more ways to capture and personalise their photographs.
 Through the partnership, vivo hopes to connect the growing importance of photography in everyday self-expression with the individuality and creativity represented by the three K-pop stars.
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by vivo Singapore (@vivo_singapore) 
 The announcement marks another brand collaboration for members of ENHYPEN, whose influence continues to extend beyond music into fashion and lifestyle.
 The vivo V80 will be introduced across Southeast Asian markets in phases, with specific availability details to be announced locally.
 Fans can find further information about the collaboration and upcoming product availability through vivo Singapore's official website .
